newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-THE SEASON IS OVER FOR INJURED ROCHE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THE SEASON IS OVER FOR INJURED ROCHE.

text.p: Paris St Germain's central defender Alain Roche will miss the remainder of the soccer season because of a badly injured knee, his club said on Tuesday.
Roche, 29, will undergo surgery for torn ligaments on his right knee next week and will be out of action for five to six months, PSG said.
Roche, who had only recently returned after a two-month injury break, hurt the knee he had been nursing in a fall during Saturday's 1-1 draw at home to Cannes.
